narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**A blanket rename is not safe.** 1291 hits, 94 files.

| Zone | Hits | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Service JS vars and params | ~950 | Safe to rename |
| SQL text in repo files | 250 | Needs a real migration first |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Frozen. Applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Frozen. Regenerated on refresh |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Frozen. Public contract |

`docs/openapi.yaml` names the frozen public field. So does the right side of `WIRE`, at [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8).

Audit lines carry it too, at [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8). Log consumers read that key.

Next: sign off on the JS identifiers only.
